findings.title: Fallback locale translation files are only force-loaded within web requests
findings.body: I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! (added in set_locale) is the only place that forces the whole fallback chain (current locale, site default locale, :en) to be loaded via I18n.ensure_loaded!. The lazy-loading patch in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb only loads the currently-active I18n.locale on a translate() call (load_locale(config.locale)), not the fallback locales. Any code path that calls I18n.t outside of ApplicationController#set_locale — background jobs, Sidekiq workers, ActionMailer deliveries, rake tasks, console sessions — will never call ensure_loaded!, so when a translation is missing for the active locale, the fallback lookup for e.g. :en can silently fail (return nil / raise MissingTranslationData) even though the English translation file exists on disk, because that locale's YAML was never actually loaded into the backend. This can produce missing/blank translations specifically in background contexts where fallback behavior is most needed.

findings.title: FallbackLocaleList#[] recomputes and hits SiteSetting on every call instead of memoizing
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList overrides Hash#[] to always compute [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact on every invocation rather than storing/memoizing the result in the underlying Hash. Since I18n's Fallbacks backend module calls I18n.fallbacks[locale] on essentially every translate() call (not just on a miss), this means SiteSetting.default_locale is invoked repeatedly on the hot translation path instead of once per locale, adding avoidable overhead compared to the stock I18n::Locale::Fallbacks implementation, which memoizes per-locale fallback chains in the hash itself.

findings.title: FallbackLocaleList subclasses Hash but never populates the underlying hash store
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList < Hash entirely overrides [] without ever calling super or storing values via []=/store, so the object itself remains an empty Hash. Any code that treats I18n.fallbacks as an actual Hash (e.g. enumerating via each/keys/to_a, or gems/tools that introspect configured fallback mappings) will see an empty collection instead of real data, even though direct [] lookups work correctly. This is fragile and can break downstream code that reasonably assumes I18n.fallbacks is a real, iterable Hash.

findings.title: No tests added for new fallback locale behavior
findings.body: This PR introduces non-trivial new behavior (FallbackLocaleList, I18n.ensure_loaded!, and the controller's forced pre-loading of the fallback chain) but adds no specs verifying that translations correctly fall back to the site default locale or to :en, nor that ensure_loaded! actually loads the required locale files. Given the subtlety of the lazy-loading/fallback interaction (see related finding about non-web contexts), this feature needs direct test coverage to avoid silent regressions.

findings.title: I18n fallbacks now enabled globally instead of only in production/profile/cloud66 environments
findings.body: Previously config.i18n.fallbacks = true was only set in config/environments/production.rb, profile.rb, and config/cloud/cloud66/files/production.rb. This PR removes those settings and instead enables fallbacks unconditionally for every environment via config/initializers/i18n.rb, including development and test. This is a behavior change beyond what the removed lines implied: specs or development workflows that previously relied on missing translations raising/being visibly flagged (rather than silently falling back to English) will now behave differently, which could mask incomplete translation work until it reaches a real fallback path in production anyway.
